lesson.title: Composing transformations in order
externalRequires: P101 U01 programming readiness as specified at U02-L05.
lesson.purpose: Compute a product of two small matrices and relate order to successive transformations.
lesson.scope: Derive the 2-by-2 product from successive matrix-vector application; rightmost transformation acts first; contrast a noncommuting pair with identity and a simple commuting pair.
lesson.boundary: Do not generalise noncommutativity to a claim that every pair fails to commute. No general rotation-angle formula or new trigonometry syllabus.
lesson.practiceAndEvidence: Calculate a shear/reflection composition both ways, compare on coordinate vectors and an independent vector; hand-trace and run a supplied short scalar/list function.
lesson.visualPlan: Two transformation paths from the same starting figure, with intermediate states.
lesson.python: 0.5 hour included: reuse P101 functions/lists to compare successive applications with the hand-computed product; no matrix library.
lesson.handover: L03–L04 solve coupled equations; L05 returns to reversible and collapsed transformations.
